name: Nyikara Jiwanta
source:
Nyikara is Pandawa's childhood friend. She started to live at the palace at a very young age, and become a respected royal dancer there.

She is very kind and good hearted, which led the Pandawas to feel more comfortable around her. Her dancing is graceful as it was also beautiful, calming every souls that laid eyes on her performance.
